subject: Customer reference: Astra Health — regional translation & sign-off plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Wu <sara.wu@astrahealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Permission request: customer reference for regional marketing — Astra Health

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the great conversation last week. We put together a short draft case study (attached) that highlights Astra Health’s success with Redwood Dedicated in your telemetry pipeline. We'd like to include a short quote and publish the case study on our website and in a regional marketing pack (EU and APAC).

Two asks:
- Can Astra confirm high-level approval to include the quoted metrics in the attached EN draft?
- For EU and APAC, would Astra prefer localized language versions (we can handle translations) or simply the English version with localized page headers?

If helpful, I can route a short legal approval form to your legal team. Target publish window we discussed was mid-November.

Attachments (stubs): Astra_case_study_EN_v1.pdf (pdf)

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0193

From: Sara Wu <sara.wu@astrahealth.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Astra Health Legal <legal@astrahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 09:40:00 +0800
Subject: Re: Permission request: customer reference for regional marketing — Astra Health

Marissa —

Appreciate the draft. High level: Astra is happy to be a reference and the metrics look correct. We do need an internal legal sign-off before public publishing — I’ve looped in our legal team.

Regarding localization: for EU markets (especially DE, FR, ES) we prefer native language PDFs on regional microsites. For APAC, English plus localized callouts (e.g., Japanese summary) is fine, but we need cultural review for any direct quotes in JP.

I attached a short internal checklist that legal wants filled for case studies (redaction options, sharing controls). Our legal team will respond this week.

Attachments (stubs): Astra_internal_checklist_for_case_studies.xlsx (xlsx)

Best,
Sara Wu
Head of Partnerships, Astra Health
sara.wu@astrahealth.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Permission request: customer reference for regional marketing — Astra Health

Thanks Sara (and Marissa for running this).

Plan proposal (internal):
1) Confirmed items to publish: high-level metrics (as in EN draft). Ask legal: any metric granularity to redact?
2) Localization scope:
   - EU: translate full case study to German, French, Spanish. QA by native reviewer + Astra contact.
   - APAC: produce English master + JP summary + simplified CN summary; JP requires cultural/quote review.
3) Timeline: translation vendor estimates — 5 business days per language once approved copy is final; turnaround target to Astra for review: Nov 9. Aim to publish regionally by Nov 16 if legal clears.
4) Ownership: Marissa handles Astra comms & legal routing; Laura owns design/asset builds for each region; Nikhil to confirm localization compliance (data residency and any EU phrasing constraints).

Marissa — can you ask Astra legal for the checklist answers and whether they require anonymization of any customer identifiers? I’ll draft the mutual action plan and share vendor options.

-Vivek
Director, GTM Partnerships
Vivek.Kulkarni@redwood.ai
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Permission request: customer reference for regional marketing — Astra Health

Quick notes from design/localization planning —

- Translation vendor quote (vendor shortlist attached): three vendors: LingoCraft, AtlasLocal, and KotoTrans. LingoCraft fastest for DE/FR/ES, KotoTrans best for JP nuance.
- Estimated cost: ~USD 1,200 per full-language translation (DE/FR/ES) for the ~850-word case study; JP summary ~USD 300; CN simplified summary ~USD 250.
- Asset work: we’ll need localized screenshots (mask PII) and localized captions. Timeline: once copy is final and vendor selected, production ~4 business days per region.

Attachments (stubs): Astra_translation_scope.xlsx, localization_timeline_v2.xlsx

Also: we should get Astra to sign a visibility window (30 days draft review) — otherwise review cycles push us into late November.

Laura Bennett
Senior Product Designer, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Wu <sara.wu@astrahealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>, Astra Health Legal <legal@astrahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 14:05:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Permission request: customer reference for regional marketing — Astra Health

Sara —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for looping legal. Per internal planning (below) we’ll:
- Proceed with full translations for DE/FR/ES, JP summary and CN simplified summary.
- Provide localized screenshots with masked identifiers.
- Share a 30-day review window for each language variant.

Next steps for Astra:
1) Please confirm via reply if the EN metrics may be published verbatim or if any redaction is required.
2) Legal: if you can complete the checklist and sign the short marketing release linked here: https://secure.docusign.com/Astra-release-2026 (stub), that will unblock translations.

We’ve attached the translation scope and timeline. Once we receive legal sign-off we’ll kick the vendor and share localized drafts in HubSpot + Drive for your reviewers.

Attachments (stubs): Astra_translation_scope.xlsx, localization_timeline_v2.xlsx, Astra_case_study_EN_v1.pdf
Drive link: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/0Axyz/Astra-CaseStudy
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deals/D-2025-9843

Appreciate it — please let me know if Astra prefers a translator NDA before we share working drafts.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0193
